answers.how: The football is approximately 28 px long. Its fall gives a pixel acceleration of about 802 px/s², so the scale is 9.8/802 ≈ 0.0122 m/px.
The football is approximately 16 px wide; multiplying by the gravity-calibrated scale of 0.0122 m/px gives about 0.19 m.
The middle yellow door spans approximately 158 px vertically. Using 0.0122 m/px gives about 1.93 m.
The middle yellow door spans approximately 72 px horizontally. Using 0.0122 m/px gives about 0.88 m.
The football's trajectory fits y ≈ 101 + 401t² pixels, giving a speed of about 401 px/s at 0.5 s. The gravity-calibrated scale converts this to 4.9 m/s.
